parameters.content:
### How it works
Each Monday, one quoted, linked row per mention.

### Setup
Get a key at https://arcmira.com/sign-up?src=n8n-competitor-mentions-sheet&utm_source=n8n&utm_campaign=n8n-competitor-mentions-sheet, then follow notes 1 to 5.

### What Arcmira returns
Arcmira returns the exact quote and a watch link cued to the second, so the reader can check the source. This template makes four calls:
- `GET /v1/me`: where results stop.
- `GET /v1/entities/resolve`: one entity id per name.
- `GET /v1/mentions`: each mention, its video, second and description, and on Pro+ its commercial class.
- `GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}?quality=captions&timestamps=true`: the timed lines around that second.

Resolve and `/v1/me` use no credits. A mention uses 4 credits. A caption transcript uses 4 credits per started 15 minutes. An ad read or recommendation uses 40 credits.

### Build this with your agent
```
Use Arcmira (the arcmira MCP server, or its API with my key). Every Monday, add the last 14 days of YouTube mentions of COMPETITOR_ONE and COMPETITOR_TWO to a Google Sheet.
1. Resolve each name to one entity (GET /v1/entities/resolve). Tell me if it had to assume.
2. List its mentions since 14 days ago (GET /v1/mentions?entity_id=...&after=...), following next_cursor. Check arcmira.status() (GET /v1/me) first. If it shows freshness, set after 14 days before served_through and quote Arcmira's note.
3. Read the transcript from 60 seconds before each start_seconds to 90 after (GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}?quality=captions&timestamps=true&start=...&end=...). Quote the whole sentence naming it, word for word from its first word to its last, up to 300 characters.
4. Write one row per mention id to a Google Sheet, or a CSV with every field in quotes if you have no Sheets tool: competitor, date, show, video title, the mention's media.url with &t={start_seconds}s, quote, description.
Check it worked: run it once, show me the rows, and confirm each quote is in the transcript at that second.
```

### 1. Who and when
Runs Mondays at 8:00. **Settings** holds your competitors, comma separated, and a few words on what they do, for names several companies share. An Arcmira id like `ent_125036` works in place of a name. The window is 14 days, since some videos are indexed days after they're published. **Check the plan's dates** reads `GET /v1/me`, which uses no credits. On the Free plan the window is the 14 days that end where the plan's results stop. **Get rows from the sheet** reads the mention ids the sheet already has. On Pro+ and above, `ad_reads` true fills the `ad_read` column, at 40 credits for every ad read or recommendation in each video it checks.

### 2. Find each competitor
`GET /v1/entities/resolve` turns each name into one entity. A name Arcmira can't place, or only assumes, becomes a note row with the ids to paste.

Pick a **Header Auth** credential here and in notes 1, 3 and 4, named `Authorization` with the value `Bearer <your key>`.

### 3. Mentions from Arcmira
`GET /v1/mentions` returns each mention published in the window, 100 a page, following `next_cursor`. One row per mention, keyed on its id. A mention the sheet already has is skipped, so the overlap between weeks adds no rows and reads no transcript twice. With `ad_reads` on it asks for `details=full`, and `ad_read` is yes when a sponsored row's span holds the mention's second. On the Free plan the list stops where the plan's results stop, and the sheet gets Arcmira's note on it as one note row. **Name a failed read** keeps the competitor's name on a read that fails, for its note row.

### 4. Quote what was said
`GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}?quality=captions&timestamps=true` reads 150 seconds around the mention. The quote is the whole sentence that holds it, up to about 300 characters, and allows for misspellings of the name. A whole-episode mention reads the full transcript and links the first line that names the competitor.

### 5. Write the sheet
Adds or updates rows by `mention_id`, notes first, then mentions, oldest first. Pick this sheet in **Get rows from the sheet** too. Row 1 of the sheet: `mention_id, found_on, competitor, published, show, video, said_at, link, what_was_said, why_it_came_up, ad_read, views`
